product_facts: This article walks through the connection steps for: Claude ChatGPT
The Adobe Workfront MCP server lets you work with your Workfront data through natural-language conversation in a supported AI agentic platform.
Your Workfront instance must be enabled on Adobe Identity Management System (IMS).

Your Workfront administrator controls MCP server access for your Workfront instance through two toggles in System Preferences: Read-only MCP tools (enabled by default) and Write MCP tools (disabled by default).

If you use an enterprise version of an AI agentic platform, your administrator for that platform must enable the Adobe Workfront connector for your organization or give you custom URL access to connect to the Workfront MCP server.
Each connection ties an AI agentic platform to a single Workfront instance.
The AI agentic platform acts in Workfront using your Workfront account, access level, and object permissions. A tool only works if you have the corresponding access in Workfront.
Find Adobe Workfront in the connector list.
If you use a different MCP-compatible AI agentic platform (for example, Gemini or Microsoft Copilot), follow the steps in that platform's documentation for adding a custom MCP server.
To use MCP with Workfront Planning, your organization must be on a Workfront package that includes Adobe Workfront Planning.

connection_how: Your Marketo administrator creates credentials for a dedicated user, and your team connects Claude Desktop or Claude Code to Marketo Engage and asks for look-ups and changes in plain words.
product_facts: The Marketo MCP server connects your AI assistant to Marketo. It supports operations across asset management, lead data, and campaign automation.
Adobe hosts the Marketo MCP server and exposes it at a public URL. Any MCP client that supports remote servers over streamable HTTP transport may connect to it.
To connect to Claude Desktop, download marketo-mcp-bridge.zip and unpack it.
In Claude Code, run /mcp to check the connection.
Use a dedicated API user in Marketo with only the permissions required for your work.
Munchkin ID allowlist. The server only accepts requests for approved Marketo instances. Requests using an unauthorized Munchkin ID are rejected with a 403 error.
Contact your Marketo MCP administrator to enable MCP access for your Munchkin Account ID.
For connections that use Marketo client credentials, the following capabilities are not supported: SMS tools Push notification tools In-app message and in-app program tools
Some operations that change or delete data require confirmation and additional access.
